description.value: The Tla-o-qui-aht Tribal Parks are an Indigenous-governed network of protected lands and waters on the west coast of Vancouver Island, encompassing the largest intact coastal temperate rainforest on the island around Tofino and Clayoquot Sound. Established in 1984 by the Tla-o-qui-aht First Nation, the parks protect over 75,000 hectares of critical habitat and operate under traditional Tla-o-qui-aht law and the concept of ʔiisaak (deep respect). Touring cyclists passing through the Tofino area ride through this territory and are invited to take the ʔiisaak Pledge and engage with the Tribal Parks Allies network of local businesses committed to land stewardship.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at tribalparks.com is fully accessible and describes a real, active Indigenous land stewardship and visitor attraction organization near Tofino, BC covering 75,650+ hectares of protected coastal temperate rainforest. No OSM tags are present and the website content contains no mention of cyclist-specific infrastructure such as bike parking, washrooms, water refill, showers, or any other checklist amenities — all criteria must be null. The OSM record has no phone or address to confirm, and the website URL matches the OSM url field.
concerns: No physical address or phone number available in OSM or on the website homepage — the Tribal Parks span a large territory rather than a single address, which may complicate directory listings.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, publicly accessible Indigenous attraction and land stewardship organization in the Tofino area; always_include flag is set and the website confirms ongoing operations as of 2026.
enrichment_extras.notes: This entry represents the overarching Tla-o-qui-aht Tribal Parks organization rather than a single physical site; cyclists encounter this territory throughout the Tofino/Clayoquot Sound area. The Tribal Parks Allies program (115 certified businesses) may be worth cross-referencing for individual business listings.

blurb: Tla-o-qui-aht Nation's tribal parks protecting Clayoquot Sound's ancient rainforest.
